svg.aria-label: Technical skills. Earth system models: SONTINH (my GPU 2-D flood model), SWAT and SWAT+, WRF-Chem (dust and aerosol), NASA Land Information System, NOAA National Water Model, HAND flood mapping, HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS. Data assimilation and calibration: Ensemble Kalman filter, SMAP soil moisture assimilation, Multi-objective calibration (KGE, NSE), Sensitivity and uncertainty analysis. Satellite Earth observation: SMAP, Sentinel-1, SWOT, NISAR InSAR, PACE, MODIS, Landsat, OpenET, Google Earth Engine. Climate and reanalysis data: ERA5 and ERA5-Land, MERRA-2, CMIP6, CHIRPS, ESA CCI, AERONET, USGS and NOAA water data. Machine learning: PyTorch (multi-GPU), TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, CNN, LSTM. Scientific computing: Python (NumPy, xarray, pandas, Numba), CUDA, Rust, Fortran, R, MATLAB, MPI on many-core Linux servers, Bash. Geospatial: GDAL, Rasterio, Cartopy, QGIS, ArcGIS, PostgreSQL. Visualization and software: Matplotlib, Blender (Cycles), PyVista, React, TypeScript, MapLibre, deck.gl, Swift, LaTeX, Docker, GitHub Actions, Zenodo.
